title: Biology revision
goal: Show a structured biology revision map spanning core topic areas and study sub-topics.

rubric.must: Biology Revision is visibly the central root of the map.
Cell Biology, Genetics, Human Physiology, and Ecology visibly branch from the central topic.
Cell Biology and Genetics visibly expand to organelles or transport and DNA or inheritance sub-topics.
Human Physiology and Ecology visibly expand to their named system and ecosystem sub-topics.
Specific revision leaves such as diffusion and osmosis, Punnett squares, vaccination, and natural selection are visible.
The diagram visibly distinguishes root, subject areas, sub-topics, and detailed study leaves.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 preserves the required four branches, specific revision leaves, and visible hierarchy, while Image 2 replaces required subjects and omits key details.
